MARCUS BRODY
Lead Product & UX Designer  •  Design Systems & Mobile Experiences
New York, NY  •  (555) 392-7104  •  m.brody.design@example.com  •  marcusbrodydesign.example.com  •  dribbble.com/marcusb-dummy
DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & SUMMARY
Human-centered Lead Product Designer with 6+ years specializing in complex multi-platform SaaS products, consumer mobile apps, and scalable design systems. Expert at translating user empathy and quantitative telemetry into high-converting, intuitive digital journeys. Champion of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and cross-functional alignment between engineering and product.
TOOLKIT & METHODOLOGIES
• Design & Prototyping: Figma (Variables, Auto-Layout, Components), Principle, Adobe Creative Cloud, Framer
• User Research & Testing: UserTesting.com, Maze, Moderated Usability Interviews, Card Sorting, Journey Mapping, Heatmaps
• Front-End Knowledge: HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Component Architecture, Git workflows
WORK EXPERIENCE
Lead Product Designer  |  Kinetix Health App
Jan 2022 – Present  •  New York, NY
Led end-to-end redesign of patient onboarding flow on iOS and Android, boosting first-week retention by 27% and customer satisfaction (CSAT) to 4.8/5.
Architected and governed the 'Kinetix Canvas' multi-brand design system with 250+ accessible components, decreasing engineering sprint turnaround by 35%.
Conducted 45+ bi-weekly moderated user testing sessions, turning qualitative insights into high-impact roadmap bets.
Senior UX/UI Designer  |  Studio Pixel & Form
Jun 2019 – Dec 2021  •  Brooklyn, NY
Delivered comprehensive responsive web platforms for 12 fintech and direct-to-consumer clients, winning 2 Webby nominations.
Facilitated 3-day Design Sprint workshops with client founders and engineering directors to align on MVP features.
EDUCATION
B.F.A. in Graphic & Interactive Media Design  •  Rhode Island School of Design (RISD), 2019
